lead: A band with a heading, a description and the people in that department. Stack several to show the whole organisation, each band with its own tone.

people.title: The heading is the department
people.role: and each person is a level-four heading
people.text: Stacked bands form one outline, not five competing sections.

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his fifties.

people.title: The line belongs to the intro
people.text: So a band without a heading never shows a line above nothing.

image.alternative: Portrait of a woman in her fifties.

people.title: Compact tightens the band
people.role: and drops the line under each name
people.text: Use it when the names matter and the notes do not, for example in the middle of a long stack.

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his thirties.
